result.summary: Reviewed existing T2 Blade/controller wiring; no scoped code changes were necessary. php artisan view:cache is blocked by tempnam() warning because the compiled-view cache directory is not writable by the running process.

verification.summary: Exit 1: tempnam(): file created in the system's temporary directory while compiling resources/views/welcome.blade.php; Laravel converts the warning to ErrorException.

discoveries: Root route is wired to PortfolioController@index and named portfolio.home.
PortfolioController passes config('portfolio') without fabricated data.
Blade layout and portfolio view contain the requested semantic sections and honest placeholders.
risks: View cache verification cannot complete until storage/framework/views ownership or permissions are corrected.
